name: Rice Krispie Treats
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch pan with butter.
Melt butter in a large pot over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted. Remove from heat.
Add Rice Krispies and fold until fully coated.
Press mixture firmly into prepared pan using a buttered spatula.
Let cool 30 minutes before cutting into squares.

substitutions.vegan: Use vegan butter and vegan marshmallows.

notes: Use low heat and don't overcook — brown butter makes them chewy instead of gooey.
